text:
Taylor Reed: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. Need consensus on customer comms gating and recurring-incident handling.

Morgan Kim: On comms gating: require a filled publish checklist on the postmortem ticket before pushing the 72h summary. Checklist = postmortem_id, owner, redaction_tier, customer_note_url (if available).

Ethan Zhao: For redaction tiers, propose: Tier 0 = metrics only (auto); Tier 1 = operations + mitigations (eng sign-off); Tier 2 = anything customer-identifying or sensitive (legal+sec); Tier 3 = regulatory (exec+legal).

Taylor Reed: Agree. Add SLAs: eng sign-off within 4h, legal within 24 business hours. If legal delayed, publish Tier1 with a note that Tier2 is pending.

Morgan Kim: Recurring detection: flag tag if a similar postmortem tag appears 3 times in 90 days. When flagged, auto-create a follow-up epic and notify infra + product.

Ethan Zhao: Action tracking rule: customer_note_url must be added to the postmortem JIRA before we mark remediation complete. We'll add a webhook to post to #incidents when that field is set.

LegalBot: Reminder: redact customer-identifying requests by default. Legal will prioritize Tier2 reviews for incidents that may affect regulated customers.

Taylor Reed: OK, I'll update the playbook with the checklist and gating rules. Target: templates + playbook edits live by EOD. Owners please ack.

Morgan Kim: Ack.

Ethan Zhao: Ack.

LegalBot: Ack.
